title: Pet-Friendly Hotels in Louisville, Kentucky | PetTripFinder
meta_description: A complete visitor-market lodging census for Louisville, Kentucky and Southern Indiana. No Louisville hotel pet policy is verified yet.
introductory_copy: This market is registered and unpublished. Every listing identity is awaiting official-page capture; no pet-policy fact is asserted.
_boundary_note:
PTF-LOUISVILLE-MARKET-REBUILD-002. Greater Louisville bi-state traveller market, not the Louisville/Jefferson County MSA and not a county line.
INCLUDED: all of consolidated Louisville/Jefferson County KY, which IS this market; the Southern Indiana river cities the Louisville CVB and SoIN Tourism jointly market (Jeffersonville, Clarksville, New Albany, Sellersburg, Floyds Knobs); and the interstate lodging clusters inside that envelope on I-64, I-71, I-264 (Watterson) and I-265 (Gene Snyder).
EXCLUDED, each for a stated reason rather than by distance alone: Bullitt County and Shepherdsville -- a real I-65 South budget-lodging cluster, but outside the visitor market GoToLouisville itself publishes, and adding a county to catch highway lodging is how a census gets inflated; re-openable by founder decision. Oldham County (Crestwood, La Grange, Pewee Valley) -- inside the coordinate box but a separate residential county with no traveller lodging cluster of its own. Shelbyville, Bardstown, Elizabethtown, Corydon and Scottsburg -- each its own destination market. Northern Kentucky -- Cincinnati-owned and already censused there.
PRIOR-BUILD GAP THIS CLOSES: the coordinate box already admitted the whole metro, but only 15 discovery cells searched it and only 25 postal codes could place what they found. The northeast quadrant, the I-65 South cluster and West Louisville had no cell and no ZIP, so no hotel in them could enter the census -- which is why the prior census of 130 spans just 18 distinct postal codes.

_registration_note: PTF-LOUISVILLE-MARKET-REBUILD-002 moved this document out of the registry. launch_packages/pettripfinder/markets/*.json IS the registry, and a registered market with no launch_participation row fails the assembler gate global.launch_participation_explicit -- whose participation file is pinned by the global deployment manifest and copied into the founder's signed deployment authorization. The prior build registered Louisville before registration was a founder step; registering it here would invalidate a LIVE production deployment record. The prior authority shard is preserved at launch_packages/pettripfinder/louisville_prior_authority_001/.
